svg.title: Quantitative comparison on IRDST, TSIRMT, and LMIRSTD
svg.desc: Full comparison of fifteen infrared small-target detection methods using Pd, Fa, IoU, nIoU, and F1. DeepDIG uses the current TMM manuscript results.
svg.text: Pd, IoU, nIoU, and F1 are percentages; Fa is ×10⁻⁶. Bold indicates the best result.
